signal.title: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
signal.summary: 这项研究聚焦机器人在动态或开放环境中的运动规划，尝试让路径不仅能到达目标，也能满足安全和物理约束。

editorial.intro: 这项研究聚焦机器人在动态或开放环境中的运动规划，尝试让路径不仅能到达目标，也能满足安全和物理约束。
editorial.why_it_matters: 运动规划连接感知、世界模型和执行控制，是具身智能从算法演示走向可靠运行的关键环节。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对复杂场景、碰撞率和真实机器人上的执行效果。

evidence.title: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
evidence.excerpt: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards.
